leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of decoded JWT payload data
Use the localStorage API to store JWT tokens securely in the browser
Implement token retrieval functions to access stored JWT tokens from localStorage
Execute conditional checks to verify token existence before attempting operations
Utilize the jwt-decode library to parse and extract data from JWT tokens
Construct React components with TypeScript props to display decoded user information
Define custom hooks to encapsulate JWT storage and decoding logic for reuse
Handle token expiration scenarios by implementing time-based validation checks
Return appropriate fallback values or error states when token operations fail
Assign decoded JWT payload data to component state for dynamic UI updates
Control component rendering based on authentication status derived from token data
Modify token storage approach to include sessionStorage as an alternative persistence method
